comment: Phase 8 (APR-JE-036): the extraction and migration matrix. An ASSESSMENT: nothing here extracts, copies or implements framework code, and the framework repository is not modified. Target locations are architectural recommendations, not facts. check:framework-matrix proves that every file of the repository belongs to exactly one component and that every reference resolves; engineering/FRAMEWORK-MIGRATION-MATRIX.md is generated from this file.

frameworkReference.architectureSpecs: 01 to 15, byte-identical at both commits (blob hashes compared)

classes.universal: Reusable across all STS client websites with parameterisation only (values move to the project manifest; logic is unchanged).

classes.adapter-hosting: Belongs to one hosting provider or delivery mode.
classes.project: A fact about Jade & Ember or its delivered site; stays.

workPackages.title: Release authentication and provenance (design, decision checkpoint and local proof of concept; multi-client operating model)
workPackages.summary: Authenticated client-production release authorisation and independently verifiable build provenance (RG-14, RB-15), designed around the STS operating model (APR-JE-042): one private repository per client, STS as sole administrator, coding agents that never approve production, no extra owner machine, second GitHub account or manual signing by default. Inserted by the owner between G6-3 and G6-4 (APR-JE-041). Design only: research verified against official GitHub documentation; an evaluation of how to enforce owner approval when an agent uses the same GitHub identity (reachability boundary, a release-control repository outside the coding integration, rather than any identity or in-repository control); the simplest secure workflow; a validation plan; plan and cost; client departure and handover; then a decision checkpoint.
